status.label: Reproduce Explorer menu icon sharpness
status.detail: Treat visual sharpness separately from subjective style; the closed linked PR was not merged.

next_action.label: Compare modern and classic menus across DPI
next_action.reason: The two menu APIs use different icon-loading paths; do not apply a fixed-size bitmap change blindly.

judgment.rationale: The report describes blurry/inconsistent PowerToys Explorer context-menu icons and includes a screenshot. Its enhancement template does not negate the cosmetic rendering defect, but style preference alone is not a code root cause.
evidence: The complete body reports fuzzy right-click menu icons; the sole comment links unrelated FancyZones/Awake icon reports.
Linked PR 45413 was closed without merging, so it is not existing-fix evidence.
Image Resizer ContextMenuHandler.cpp and PowerRenameExt.cpp classic-menu paths explicitly load 16-by-16 icons and cache converted bitmaps.
PowerRename IExplorerCommand paths instead return an icon resource or ICO path; a classic bitmap fix cannot be assumed to cover modern menus.
judgment.recommended_action: Reproduce visible sharpness at several display scales and identify the actual menu API/resource before selecting a focused asset or DPI-loading correction.

fix_assessment.rationale: A measurable cosmetic-rendering correction may apply; the closed unmerged PR does not cover it and the exact surface remains to be tested.

proposed_fixes.title: Render crisp PowerToys Explorer context-menu icons at supported scales
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Hypothesis: a classic-menu fixed 16-by-16 bitmap is scaled up at higher DPI, or the relevant modern-menu ICO lacks a suitable frame. The screenshot alone does not establish which menu path or asset causes the blur.
plan: Compare PowerRename and Image Resizer in modern and classic Explorer menus at 100%, 150% and 200%, using neighboring system icons as a visual control.
Identify the invoked menu API, loaded resource and bitmap/frame dimensions; separate low-resolution rendering from subjective icon-style requests.
If classic fixed-size loading is confirmed, use the menu's appropriate DPI/system metric and matching icon frame, including cache invalidation when scale changes.
If the modern ICO asset is responsible, correct only its missing/low-quality frames; preserve menu registration, command behavior and icon-visibility settings.
Add asset/frame checks and visual validation for light/dark themes and monitor-scale transitions.
verification: Both menus select appropriately sized crisp resources at each tested DPI.
Moving Explorer between different-DPI monitors does not reuse a visibly undersized cached bitmap.
Icon visibility settings and context-menu commands remain unchanged.

confidence.rationale: Both classic handlers have concrete fixed-size loading and modern paths differ, supporting a focused test matrix. The original screenshot's exact menu surface and scale have not been independently reproduced.

issue_context.summary: PowerToys Explorer context-menu icons are reported as blurry and stylistically inconsistent; rendering sharpness is the bounded bug candidate.
known_information: The report includes a screenshot but no exact DPI/menu-surface comparison.
There is only a similarity-bot comment.
The sole linked PR was closed unmerged.
Classic and modern PowerRename menu implementations load icons differently; both classic module handlers request 16-by-16 icons.
inferences: Fixed-size bitmap scaling or asset-frame quality may explain the visual defect; a subjective redesign is a separate product decision.
issue_context.analysis: No generic PowerToys diagnostic capture would identify icon raster quality. A maintainer DPI/menu matrix can reproduce the public claim without requesting personal assets.
initial_investigation: Read the full body, bot comment and cross-reference timeline.
Checked PR 45413's state, description and changed file rather than assuming closed means fixed.
Inspected Image Resizer's classic icon loading and PowerRename's classic and IExplorerCommand icon paths.

actions.label: Review DPI-aware menu icon plan
actions.description: Approve the focused visual-rendering investigation, not a broad icon-style redesign.

actions.label: Reproduce classic/modern icon blur at DPI

prerequisites: Use a current PowerToys build and Explorer with both modern and Show more options menus available.
Prepare harmless image files and renameable test files; enable the module menu icons.
Use a development shell-extension build if resource-size tracing is needed.
steps: Open each module's context-menu item at 100%, 150% and 200% scaling and capture a cropped comparison with neighboring system icons.
Repeat in the classic Show more options menu and identify which shell API is invoked.
Inspect the selected ICO/resource frame and converted bitmap dimensions.
Repeat after moving Explorer to another-DPI monitor and after reopening Explorer; compare themes and icon-visibility controls.
reproduce.expected_result: Icons render at the intended menu size without avoidable bitmap upscaling blur, and commands/settings remain functional.
reproduce.setup_prompt: Prepare non-sensitive image and text samples and a display-scale/menu-surface comparison grid. Capture cropped menus only; inspect icon frame dimensions rather than inferring sharpness from a resized screenshot.
